## Loading packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
umich <- read.csv("../../data/raw/sca-table1-on-2026-Aug-30.csv")
Y <- as.numeric(scale(umich$Index))

## Compile models

mod_ar   <- cmdstan_model("models/ar.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))
mod_arr2 <- cmdstan_model("models/arr2.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))

# Exact population R^2 = sum(phi * rho); NA outside the stationary region.
r2_from_phi <- function(phi) {
  if (any(!is.finite(phi))) return(NA_real_)
  if (any(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -phi))) <= 1)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(phi * ARMAacf(ar = phi, lag.max = length(phi))[-1])
}
 
# NOTE: last element is always 0.1, which pushes psi to the simplex edge and
# causes divergences. Revisit before relying on the Minnesota rows.
minnesota_cons <- function(p) (p^2 / 10) * (1 / (1:p)^2)

## Configurations

p_grid  <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24)
mean_R2 <- 1/3
prec_R2 <- 3
knob_q  <- qbeta(c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95),
                 mean_R2 * prec_R2, (1 - mean_R2) * prec_R2)

configs <- list(
  list(label = "naive (sd = 1)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 1.0)),
  list(label = "naive (sd = 0.5)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 0.5)),
  list(label = "ARR2 flat", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = rep(1, p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2, prec_R2 = prec_R2)),
  list(label = "ARR2 Minn.", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2, prec_R2 = prec_R2))
)

## Running sweep

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
 
draws_list <- list()
 
results <- map_dfr(p_grid, function(p) {
  map_dfr(configs, function(cfg) {
 
    stan_data <- c(
      list(T = length(Y), Y = Y, p = p,
           sigma_sd = 1, prior_only = 1L),
      cfg$data(p)
    )
 
    fit <- cfg$model$sample(
      data            = stan_data,
      chains          = 4,
      iter_warmup     = 1000,
      iter_sampling   = 1000,
      refresh         = 0,
      show_messages   = FALSE,
      show_exceptions = FALSE
    )
 
    phi_draws <- fit$draws("phi", format = "draws_matrix")
 
    # Exact R^2 on stationary draws; non-stationary draws censored at 1
    # (gamma_0 -> infinity at the boundary, so R^2 -> 1).
    r2_exact <- apply(phi_draws, 1, r2_from_phi)
    stat     <- !is.na(r2_exact)
    r2_cens  <- ifelse(stat, r2_exact, 1)
 
    # ARR2's R2 parameter (the knob); absent in the naive model.
    r2_knob <- if ("R2" %in% fit$metadata()$stan_variables) {
      as.numeric(fit$draws("R2", format = "draws_matrix"))
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, length(stat))
    }
 
    diag <- fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
 
    draws_list[[paste(cfg$label, p)]] <<- tibble(
      config = cfg$label, p = p, draw = seq_along(stat),
      stationary = stat, r2_exact = r2_exact,
      r2_cens = r2_cens, r2_knob = r2_knob
    )
 
    tibble(
      config      = cfg$label,
      p           = p,
      n_draws     = length(stat),
      prop_stat   = mean(stat),
      mcse        = sqrt(prop_stat * (1 - prop_stat) / n_draws),
      r2_med      = median(r2_cens),
      r2_q05      = unname(quantile(r2_cens, 0.05)),
      r2_q95      = unname(quantile(r2_cens, 0.95)),
      r2_stat_med = if (any(stat)) median(r2_exact[stat]) else NA_real_,
      knob_med    = median(r2_knob, na.rm = TRUE),
      divergences = sum(diag$num_divergent),
      max_rhat    = max(fit$summary("phi")$rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
})

all_draws <- bind_rows(draws_list)

print(results %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))), n = Inf)

write_csv(results,   "results/prior_r2_consistency.csv")
write_csv(all_draws, "results/prior_r2_draws.csv")
```

```{r}
p_r2 <- results %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, r2_med, colour = config, fill = config)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = knob_q, linetype = c(3, 2, 3), colour = "grey40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = r2_q05, ymax = r2_q95), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p",
       y = expression("Prior-implied " * R^2 * " (non-stationary = 1)"),
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Prior-implied R-squared by lag order",
       subtitle = "Median and 90% band; grey lines = ARR2 knob Beta quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
p_stat <- results %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, prop_stat, colour = config)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = prop_stat - 2 * mcse,
                      ymax = prop_stat + 2 * mcse)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = "Proportion of prior draws stationary",
       colour = NULL, title = "Stationary prior mass by lag order") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
p_knob <- all_draws %>%
  filter(!is.na(r2_knob), stationary, p %in% c(1, 3, 8, 24)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(r2_knob, r2_exact)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2) +
  facet_grid(config ~ p, labeller = label_both) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "ARR2 R2 parameter (knob)", y = "Exact implied R-squared",
       title = "Knob vs realised R-squared (stationary draws)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
